In ticketing systems, a back to back ticket, also known as double booking, is a pair of tickets for the same event that are booked and sold in different parts of the industry (often in different languages). Back to backs are usually offered by agencies (or their parent company) that specialise in high pressure marketing, particularly by using high volumes of agents to try and inflate the number of sales through false pre-sales (called soft-sells ). Back to backs can also occur when tickets are issued directly by the venue and are discounted only when purchased in groups.
The distinction with an ordinary soft sell is that both tickets are valid for entry into the place where the back to back comes from (as opposed to being valid only for entry to either venue if purchased separately). An agent selling back to back tickets can thus claim that what they sold was 'double that'.
